title: QR posters
seoDescription: Printable QR posters that open your reporting portal.
intro: Each poster opens one portal address and carries your own text in English and Arabic. Download it as a PDF to print.
formIntro: Write everything the poster says; nothing is added for you. Save to see the preview, which is exactly what the PDF will look like.
emptyBody: Create a poster for your organization's portal or for one of your entities, then download it as a PDF.
noAddress: This poster has no address to encode yet. Give the entity a portal address first.

list.name: Name
list.notDownloadable: This poster can't be downloaded yet.
list.downloadFailed: The PDF couldn't be created. Try again.

delete.title: Delete poster?
delete.message: “{{name}}” will be deleted. Posters already printed keep working: they open the portal address, not this record.

form.name: Poster name
form.nameHint: Only you see this, e.g. “Insurance lobby”.
form.activeHint: A switched-off poster can be previewed but not downloaded.
form.heading: Heading

errors.sizeRequired: Choose at least one paper size.
errors.headingRequired: Write the heading in English, Arabic or both.
errors.unknownEntity: That entity isn't active. Choose another address.
errors.noAddresses: No portal address is ready yet. Set one up on the Portal page first.

preview.title: Preview
preview.unsaved: Save the poster to see the preview.
preview.note: A4 and A3 use the same layout. The preview is exactly what the PDF prints.
